li.label: reunited with family
li.description: Family I thought was gone came walking up the road, and now they sleep down the hall from me.

li.label: my family was turned away
li.description: My family found me after all those years, and the colony sent them back down the road. They kept looking back.

li.label: back with an old comrade
li.description: An old comrade is with me again. I don't have to explain anything to them.

li.label: an old friend was turned away
li.description: An old friend came all this way, and the answer went down to them at the road. They didn't even argue.

li.label: my old flame is here
li.description: My old flame has moved in. We haven't talked about how it ended, and I'm not sorry they came.

li.label: my partner's ex moved in
li.description: My partner's ex lives here now. I see them at every meal, smiling.

li.label: they came back
li.description: I always hoped they'd come back. It's good to see them at the table again.

li.label: they came back
li.description: We were rid of them. Now they're back, acting like nothing happened.

li.label: they let me come home
li.description: After everything, they let me come home. I won't forget who opened the gate.

li.label: the colony stood by me
li.description: They came for me, for what I used to be, and the colony said no. I owe these people everything now.

li.label: the colony paid for me
li.description: The colony paid good silver to settle my old mistakes. I watched it go out to the gate.

li.label: we gave up one of our own
li.description: We handed one of us over to the people who came for them. Whatever they did before, they were ours.

li.label: my old debt is paid
li.description: What I owed from my old life is settled. I don't have to watch the road anymore.

li.label: my past caught up with me
li.description: The people I owe have tracked me down. I'd thought all that was a long way behind me.

li.label: an inheritance
li.description: Word came that someone from my old life has died, and remembered me at the end.

li.label: word from my old teacher
li.description: My old teacher is still alive, and still sure I'm doing it wrong. I've gone over every word twice.

li.label: good news from home
li.description: Word came from home, and it was good for once. I've told it to anyone who'll listen.

li.label: my old home is gone
li.description: The place I came from is gone. I can never go back now.

li.label: someone came to learn from me
li.description: A young traveler asked for me at the gate before they'd even set down their pack. They want to learn from me, of all people.

li.label: I found my master
li.description: The master from the stories is real, and here. I want to learn everything they know.

li.label: they took me in
li.description: I ran from everything I knew, and these people took me in. I have a bed now, and a place at the table.

li.label: beat the traveling champion
li.description: A champion came a long way to beat me, and I won. They'll be telling this one on the road.

li.label: lost to the traveling champion
li.description: The champion beat me while the others watched. I'll be practicing every evening until they come back.

li.label: our champion won
li.description: One of ours beat the traveling champion. Somebody ought to buy them a drink.

li.label: felled the great beast
li.description: I brought down a beast out of the old stories. My hands didn't stop shaking until supper.

li.label: the great beast is down
li.description: One of ours brought down the beast from the old stories. I went out to see the size of it.

li.label: tamed a living legend
li.description: The others wanted to kill the great beast. It eats from my hand now.

li.label: we paid tribute
li.description: We handed over our silver because they had an army behind them.

li.label: we refused to bow
li.description: They demanded tribute, and we refused. Let them come.

li.label: the map was true
li.description: We followed a stranger's scrap of a map, and the treasure was right where the mark said. I can't stop grinning.

li.label: swindled
li.description: We paid good silver for a map that led to nothing. I'll know that face if I ever see it again.

li.label: saw the fireflies
li.description: Thousands of fireflies came up out of the grass after dark. I stood out in them until my neck ached from looking up.

li.label: caught in the hail
li.description: I got caught out in hail the size of knuckles. My ears are still ringing.

li.label: the comet is a good omen
li.description: Where I come from, a comet means luck. I've been making plans by it.

li.label: the comet is a bad omen
li.description: A comet in the sky never means anything good. My grandmother always said so.

li.label: the comet
li.description: A tail of light across the whole sky. I go out every night to see if it's still there.

li.label: my animal saved the stores
li.description: Vermin got into the food stores, and my animal caught them before anyone else noticed.

li.label: found a buried cache
li.description: I dug up a cache that was hidden long ago and never collected. Whoever hid it must have meant to come back.

li.label: the land is generous
li.description: The land is giving more than we ever planted. I came back from a short walk with my hands full.

li.label: an evening of tales
li.description: A traveler told us stories all evening, about faraway places and terrible battles. We kept the fire going long after we should have been in bed.

li.label: strangers honored our dead
li.description: Strangers came a long way just to stand at one of our graves, and they stood there a good while.

li.label: we fed the pilgrims
li.description: The pilgrims ate every bite we gave them. They'll be praying for us somewhere down the road.

li.label: we turned away the hungry
li.description: They only asked for a meal. We had a meal.

li.label: a stray chose me
li.description: It followed me all the way home and wouldn't leave. I didn't try very hard to make it.

li.label: had to let the stray go
li.description: The stray was walked out to the edge of the fields and left there. It sat and watched us go.

li.label: a lost child went home
li.description: Somewhere out there, a family got their child back because of us.

li.label: we kept someone's child
li.description: A family is still out there searching, and we know exactly where their child is.

li.label: they kept me from my family
li.description: I was lost, and they found me, but they didn't take me home. They're nice to me here, but I want my family.

li.label: talked all night with a scholar
li.description: I talked all night with a visiting scholar who saw things in my work I'd never thought of. My head is still buzzing.

li.label: the lost child came back
li.description: We walked a lost child home once. Now they've come back, grown, to say thank you.

li.label: kindness repaid
li.description: Those pilgrims we fed made it to the end of their road, and sent back what they could spare.

li.label: we held
li.description: They came for us, and we sent them running. Every one of us is still here.

li.label: we held, at a price
li.description: We drove them off, but not all of us lived to see it.

li.label: hero of the fight
li.description: The others saw what I did in that fight. People keep stopping me to hear it again.

li.label: a job well done
li.description: We said we'd do it, and we did. The colony's word is good.

li.label: they sold one of us
li.description: A stranger offered silver for one of us, and the council took it. I wonder what they'd take for me.

li.label: the council let me choose
li.description: A stranger offered to pay for me, and the council let me decide. I chose to stay.

li.label: they wrote well of us
li.description: Someone from outside has put our colony on paper, and they got it right.

li.label: they wrote badly of us
li.description: What's going round about us out there isn't kind, and I can't say it's all wrong.

li.label: music in the air
li.description: There's been music in the air, and the work goes easier for it.

li.label: met someone famous
li.description: I met someone famous and actually talked with them! The folks back home would never believe it.
